title: Design-Build Modernization of the LPOE in Lynden, Washington Sources Sought
description:
KENNETH G. WARD (LYNDEN) LAND PORT OF ENTRY  

 The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA), Public Buildings Service Capital Construction Branch is seeking capable and experienced Design-Build firms for the modernization of the Land Port of Entry, located in Lynden, Washington through this Sources Sought notice. 

 The Land Port of Entry in Lynden Washington, occupying approximately 10.3 acres, is located along the US-Canadian border at the northern end of Washington State Route (SR) 539 (aka Guide-Meridian Road). The port, which is approximately six miles north of the city of Lynden, Washington, is located approximately ten miles to the east of the Peace Arch and Pacific Highway Land Ports of Entry (which are in nearby Blaine Washington), and is located approximately ten miles to the west of the Sumas Land Port of Entry. The existing port in Lynden was last modernized in the late 1980s. 

 This announcement is issued solely for market research and planning purposes. It does  not  constitute a solicitation, request for proposals, or offer. No contract will be awarded from this notice. The Government will not reimburse respondents for any costs associated with submission of information in response to this notice.
